text: Agreed to hold steady endurance effort on climbs rather than surging, keeping breathing conversational and cadence comfortable through the middle hours of rides. Final riser feeling harder than usual was attributed to headwind and fatigue from a long day on feet, not a fitness decline.

On the exposed river stretch when wind picks up: tuck lower on the bars and rotate snack schedule earlier to stay energised through the final hour. Agreed to monitor hand and shoulder comfort in the lower position as weekly volume builds.

Back-to-back ride protocol: mild leg heaviness clearing within 20 minutes is considered normal at this build stage — no plan change. Rule set: if heaviness lingers past 30 minutes on day 2, shorten the ride rather than push through.
